scenes.tts: If the brain trusts the stretch line, what turns stretch into a signal on it?
scenes.visual: Title card: The Channel on the Line. A spindle ending with a question mark on its membrane.
scenes.narration: If the brain trusts the stretch line, what turns stretch into a signal on it?

scenes.tts: A candidate is Piezo two, a mechanically activated channel. Force opens it.
scenes.caption: A candidate is Piezo2, a mechanically activated channel. Force opens it.
scenes.visual: A schematic three-bladed channel, as drawn in the Piezo channels lesson, in the ending's membrane opens as the membrane is stretched. Label: Piezo2.
scenes.narration: A candidate is Piezo2, a mechanically activated channel. Force opens it.

scenes.tts: Woo and colleagues tested it in mice, in three ways.
scenes.visual: Names and date on screen: Woo and colleagues, 2015. Three empty panels appear.
scenes.narration: Woo and colleagues tested it in mice, in three ways.

scenes.tts: First, where it is. A reporter showed Piezo two in the sensory endings on spindles and tendon organs.
scenes.caption: First, where it is. A reporter showed Piezo2 in the sensory endings on spindles and tendon organs.
scenes.visual: Panel one fills: a green reporter signal on endings in a spindle and in a tendon organ. Label: where it is.
scenes.narration: First, where it is. A reporter showed Piezo2 in the sensory endings on spindles and tendon organs.

scenes.tts: Second, what current it carries. Poked cell bodies of labelled neurons gave rapidly adapting currents.
scenes.visual: Panel two fills: a probe indents a dissociated cell body while a pipette records a fast current that peaks and falls. Label: 23 of 25 labelled neurons.
scenes.narration: Second, what current it carries. Poked cell bodies of labelled neurons gave rapidly adapting currents.

scenes.tts: Third, does the ending need it? They used Cre driver lines to remove Piezo two in the cells those lines reach, including proprioceptors. Neither driver is specific to proprioceptors.
scenes.visual: Panel three: a gene flanked by two target sites is cut out in coloured cells, labelled driver-targeted cells, which include proprioceptors and some other cells. Labels: Pvalb-Cre; HoxB8-Cre.
scenes.narration: Third, does the ending need it? They used Cre driver lines to remove Piezo two in the cells those lines reach, including proprioceptors. Neither driver is specific to proprioceptors.

scenes.tts: Then they stretched an isolated muscle and recorded from its sensory nerve.
scenes.visual: An isolated muscle is pulled through its tendons while an electrode on its nerve records spikes.
scenes.narration: Then they stretched an isolated muscle and recorded from its sensory nerve.

scenes.tts: Predict. With Piezo two gone from these neurons, what happens to stretch-evoked firing?
scenes.caption: Predict. With Piezo2 gone from these neurons, what happens to stretch-evoked firing?
scenes.visual: Question on screen. Two spike rasters side by side, control and deletion; the deletion raster is blank for now.
scenes.narration: Predict. With Piezo2 gone from these neurons, what happens to stretch-evoked firing?

scenes.tts: It was sharply reduced, with either Cre line. And the mice moved with severely uncoordinated limbs.
scenes.visual: The deletion raster fills with only sparse spikes beside the dense control raster. A mouse icon with splayed, uncoordinated limbs.
scenes.narration: It was sharply reduced, with either Cre line. And the mice moved with severely uncoordinated limbs.

scenes.tts: Not quite all of it went. In one of eight muscles per line, some stretch response remained.
scenes.visual: One muscle in a row of eight lights up faintly. Label: 1 of 8 muscles per Cre line.
scenes.narration: Not quite all of it went. In one of eight muscles per line, some stretch response remained.

scenes.tts: That could be Piezo two left behind by incomplete deletion. So it is called the principal transducer.
scenes.caption: That could be Piezo2 left behind by incomplete deletion. So it is called the principal transducer.
scenes.visual: A few channels remain in an ending. The word principal appears in bold.
scenes.narration: That could be Piezo2 left behind by incomplete deletion. So it is called the principal transducer.

scenes.tts: The leftover does not prove a second channel. Nor does it rule one out.
scenes.visual: A second channel outline appears dashed, with a question mark.
scenes.narration: The leftover does not prove a second channel. Nor does it rule one out.

scenes.tts: So Piezo two is the principal channel on the stretch line. It starts the signal the brain reads as stretch.
scenes.visual: Guiding-idea card returns briefly: limb position is an estimate built mainly from spindle length signals. Piezo2 sits at the start of that line.
scenes.narration: So Piezo2 is the principal channel on the stretch line. It starts the signal the brain reads as stretch.
scenes.caption: So Piezo2 is the principal channel on the stretch line. It starts the signal the brain reads as stretch.

scenes.tts: Now a puzzle. In cultured cell bodies, the current fades with a time constant of five point six milliseconds.
scenes.caption: Now a puzzle. In cultured cell bodies, the current fades with a time constant of 5.6 milliseconds.
scenes.visual: A decay curve drawn live from its peak. Labels: tau = 5.6 ms; cell body in culture; single-exponential assumption.
scenes.narration: Now a puzzle. In cultured cell bodies, the current fades with a time constant of 5.6 milliseconds.

scenes.tts: Assume one exponential. By twenty milliseconds, only about three percent is left.
scenes.caption: Assume one exponential. By 20 milliseconds, only about 3% is left.
scenes.visual: A marker at 20 ms on the curve. Label: about 3% left.
scenes.narration: Assume one exponential. By 20 milliseconds, only about 3% is left.

scenes.tts: Zoom out to one second. The curve lies flat on the floor.
scenes.visual: The time axis zooms out from 20 ms to 1 s; the curve collapses onto the axis. Label: effectively zero.
scenes.narration: Zoom out to one second. The curve lies flat on the floor.

scenes.tts: Yet a spindle must report a muscle held at a new length for seconds. And Piezo two is needed for that held response.
scenes.caption: Yet a spindle must report a muscle held at a new length for seconds. And Piezo2 is needed for that held response.
scenes.visual: A ramp-and-hold stretch trace with steady firing during the hold. Label: Woo's stretch response, measured during the hold.
scenes.narration: Yet a spindle must report a muscle held at a new length for seconds. And Piezo2 is needed for that held response.

scenes.tts: So how does a channel this fast do it?
scenes.visual: The fast decay curve beside the long hold trace, with a question mark between them.
scenes.narration: So how does a channel this fast do it?

scenes.tts: A cell body in a dish may not behave like an ending in muscle. Other channels may carry part of the held response.
scenes.visual: Two candidate cards: cell body is not the ending; other channels may help.
scenes.narration: A cell body in a dish may not behave like an ending in muscle. Other channels may carry part of the held response.

scenes.tts: And the ending has machinery of its own. Vesicle-released glutamate helps sustain firing in a held stretch. The full pathway is not settled.
scenes.visual: A third card: the ending's own machinery, with vesicles releasing glutamate. Label: supported contributor (Than and colleagues, 2021). Label across all three: full pathway not settled.
scenes.narration: And the ending has machinery of its own. Vesicle-released glutamate helps sustain firing in a held stretch. The full pathway is not settled.

scenes.tts: Piezo two is the principal transducer on the stretch line. How it supports a held signal is still open.
scenes.caption: Piezo2 is the principal transducer on the stretch line. How it supports a held signal is still open.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: Piezo2, the principal transducer on the stretch line; the held signal, an open question.
scenes.narration: Piezo2 is the principal transducer on the stretch line. How it supports a held signal is still open.
